name: Alex Rivera
intro: I design data tools for people who don’t write code, study how teams make decisions with them, and like long walks with a camera.

about.statement: I care about the moment a confusing dataset turns into a clear decision.
about.body: I started in civil engineering, moved into analytics, and now split my time between a product team and a part-time research degree. This site collects what I build, what I write, and what I notice along the way.

contact.blurb: For a conversation, a collaboration, or just a good idea.
